description: We are taking a huge step to guarantee protected spaces for our most endangered species and habitats, and it is now law! I wrote SB3253 to establish a new network of conservation sanctuaries across our islands. Hawaii has more endangered species than the rest of the country combined, and we are losing many of them forever, every year. Yet, here our environment is our economy, our culture, our way of life, and we must do more to protect it. This model is built on proven successes in other island
